answer.link: Magic link: the email contains a URL with a token query parameter; POST /auth/verify takes { token }.
answer.code: 6-digit one-time code: the email text contains the code; POST /auth/verify takes { email, code }.

rules.answer: 15 minutes for the login credential; 24 hours for the session.
Cookie named session, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 24 h, backed by SessionStore.
Unknown emails get the identical 202 and no email is sent.
Store only a SHA-256 hash of the credential.
